scope: One final handoff SHA pass over explicitly selected NET01E documents/tools/case evidence. No bag/native-PCAP rehash; native hashes reuse five dual-copy proofs. Large raw originals remain local; only curated <=4MiB report/support files staged.
unhashed_raw_scope: Bags and unlisted raw files remain preserved in case directories; no new whole-workspace checksum claim.
self_reference: Index does not hash itself; SHA256SUMS includes this index hash and excludes itself by convention. DELIVERY_IDENTITY added in final metadata envelope.
